summary: Camtek Ltd. furnished a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) pre-announcing preliminary third-quarter 2026 revenue of $160-161 million, up 27% year over year, above prior guidance. The company guided fourth-quarter revenue to approximately $180 million, full-year 2026 to roughly $595 million, and an initial 2027 outlook above $800 million. Order intake year-to-date exceeds $800 million, with deliveries through 2026 and into 2027. CEO Rafi Amit cited AI-driven advanced packaging demand. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or structural terms are stated; routine operational update. Watch preliminary results versus early-November final print.
